role: CI guard (make snapshot-refs-guard; ci.yml, gates.yml) that every `assertSnapshot(... named: "x")` in EmuquTests has a committed EmuquTests/__Snapshots__/x.raw and every .raw has a caller.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; no cd (must be run from repo root; exit 2 if ./EmuquTests is not a directory). Python: paren-matched extraction of each `assertSnapshot(` argument span; regex `named:\s*"..."` gives the name (calls whose name is not a string literal are ignored). Stored = stems of top-level *.raw in __Snapshots__ (empty set if dir absent; subdirectories ignored). Missing or orphan -> prints each and exit 1. No assertions at all -> exit 1 (guard must not guard nothing). Else prints counts and exits 0. Does not validate reference bytes (documented).
